primary_endpoint: Percent change from baseline in liver fat by MRI-PDFF at Week 16.
efficacy_outcome: Mean percent change: placebo −7.2%; PF-05221304 2 mg −17.1%, 10 mg −49.9%, 25 mg −55.9%, and 50 mg −64.8%. Statistical comparisons were not provided.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: placebo 0/61; PF-05221304 2 mg 1/63, 10 mg 1/62, 25 mg 2/58, and 50 mg 2/61. No deaths were reported.
